kurzbeschreibung:
**

Peter’s Treff in Tirol

** **

Welcome to Peter’s Treff – your cozy spot in the heart of Tirol!

** **

Discover Authentic Tirolian Hospitality

** **

Step into a world where tradition meets warmth. At Peter’s Treff, we serve up the best of Tirolian flavors—from hearty Kaiserschmarrn to savory Tiroler Gröstl. Every dish is crafted with love, just like the stories of the Alps.

** **

Located in the Heart of Innsbruck

** **

Just a stone’s throw from Innsbruck’s golden rooftops, Peter’s Treff is your perfect retreat. Whether you’re exploring the city’s historic charm or taking a scenic hike in the Nordkette, we’re here to fuel your adventures with local specialties.

** **

Try Our Signature Dishes

** **
  • Tiroler Kaspressknödel – Soft, cheesy dumplings with a melt-in-your-mouth texture.
  • Schlutzkrapfen – Crispy fried pasta pockets stuffed with spinach and ricotta.
  • Apfelstrudel – Warm, flaky pastry filled with spiced apples.
  • Obatzda – Creamy, tangy cheese spread with a kick of paprika.
** **

Perfect for Every Occasion

** **

Whether you’re traveling solo, with family, or celebrating a special moment, Peter’s Treff offers a welcoming atmosphere. Sip on a Tiroler Bier or enjoy a steaming cup of Kaffee mit Schlag while soaking in the alpine views.

** **

Visit Us Today!

** **

Come taste the soul of Tirol at Peter’s Treff. We’re open daily—your next favorite meal awaits!

** **Plan Your Visit**
